description: Add a term to a project, or change the one named by 'id' — and confirm or reject a proposed one with 'state'. On a change, what you leave out stays as it is. A term written here is confirmed at once. 'variants' REPLACES the other spellings: send all of them — for a word that declines, the forms running text uses ('размерной подгруппы', 'размерных подгрупп'), since a text is matched by these and not by a stemmer. 'source' is the wiki page or issue that defines it — 'page:471', 'PM-12' or its address — and must be one you can open; an empty string removes it. Members of the project who may write only. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

definition.description: What it means — one or two short sentences, Markdown, $…$ for formulas; at most 600 characters.

id.description: The term to change, as list_terms returned it. Leave out to add one.

kind.description: What sort of thing it is, in the project's words — 'условие', 'спецификация', 'понятие'.

name.description: The term as written, e.g. 'PW06' or 'Размерная подгруппа'.

place.description: The heading on the source it stands under.

project.description: The project key, for a new term.

source.description: The page or issue that defines it: 'page:471', 'PM-12' or its address. '' removes it.

state.description: 'confirmed' or 'rejected' — to decide a proposed term.

variants.description: Its other spellings, one per line or comma-separated.

name: set_term
title: Set term
